examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Background
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the calendar picker dialog box's background using backgroundColor, backgroundBlurStyle, and shadow in CalendarDialogOptions.

examples.title: Example 2: Customizing the Button Style
examples.description: This example shows how to customize the calendar picker dialog box's buttons by configuring acceptButtonStyle and cancelButtonStyle in CalendarDialogOptions. This functionality is supported since API version 12.

examples.title: Example 3: Configuring a Dialog Box in the Hover State
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the layout area of a dialog box when the device is in semi-folded mode. This functionality is supported since API version 14.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Background Style for the Selected Date
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the background style of the selected date using hintRadius in CalendarOptions. This functionality is supported since API version 10.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting Start and End Dates
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the start and end dates for the calendar picker dialog box using start and end in CalendarOptions. This functionality is supported since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 6: Highlighting the Current Date and Configuring Disabled Date Ranges
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to keep the current system date highlighted in the calendar picker dialog box using the markToday property in CalendarDialogOptions and set disabled date ranges using the disabledDateRange property in CalendarOptions. This functionality is supported since API version 19.

examples.title: Example 7: Customizing the Background Blur Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the background blur effect by configuring backgroundBlurStyleOptions. This functionality is supported since API version 19.

examples.title: Example 8: Customizing the Background Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the background effect by configuring backgroundEffect. This functionality is supported since API version 19.
